title: Typography
description: The type scale (text-caption 11 … text-display 26, font-display for titles) and Prose, which styles long-form text — headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes, inline code — from that scale.
when: Help articles, release notes, policies, long AI answers (wrap Markdown in Prose).

instead.need: UI text in cards and forms

a11y: Keep a real heading order (h2 → h3); Prose caps the line length (max-w-prose) for reading.
